decision.explanation: The sources confirm four distinct individuals named Kim So-yeong with different professions: D1S1 identifies 'Fat Cat' (Kim So-yeong) as a 'singer'; D3S13 explicitly states 'Kim So-yeong is known for her versatile roles... as an actor'; D4S1 lists 'Chef Kim So-yeong' as 'Chef of the Year'; and D5S1/D6S2 identify a 'Kim So-yeong' born in 1992 as a 'South Korean badminton player'. These represent distinct valid referents (namesakes) rather than contradictions, so all four professions are retained.
